main_text.l: Anni ante Aur. | Anni Olym. ordin.Iul. num. | An.Vrb. piadici. | Litera Nabona- conditæ. | Feriæ domin. fari.
main_text.p: {a} Annus Olympiadicus 446 circa folstitium æstiuum cœpit, & ab æquinoctio verno præcedente incurrit annus vrbis conditæ 423, labente anno 286 ante ordinationem Iulianam, cuius initium fuit à præcedente bruma seu kalend.Ianuariis. Hoc anno Olympiadico 446, nocte quæ secuta est 20 diem Septembris, fuit eclipsis in oppositione luminarium: vndecima vero die post illam defectionem lunæ, hoc est, kal.Octobris, currente anno ante ordinationem Iulianam 286 copiæ Macedonum & Persarum in confpectum sese [?] dederunt, & acriter pugnatum est ad Gaugamela, vel vt alij volunt ad Arbe-

page.notes: Marks {b} and {c} after the year numbers 447 and 425 are printed as small letters beside the figures in the table; the note for {b} and {c} is not printed on this page. The text "Nou." entries in the right column are printed as short annotations beside rows 297, 293, 289, 285 and 281; their dash leaders are omitted. The word "sese" is read as "sese" with doubt, as the scan is faint there. The word "confpectum" is printed as such. The catchword "Arbe-" is at the right below the last line.
